scope: Independent actual visual review of all3 final512 PNGs flattened on black/cream and visible long-edge120/180 previews, plus read-only file/registration checks. No runtime scene or phone validation claimed.

visualReview.overall: New predatory full bodies have a forceful wide claw silhouette,3 crown spines, open black mouth, strong bone-white/purple-red material blocks. Warm matte brushwork and limited mint details fit the existing world.
visualReview.crystal: Heavy bone-white armor and amber core clearly signal the protected first stage.
visualReview.fission: Upturned cracked back armor and2 purple-red brood sacs change the upper silhouette. Amber sac centers stay visible; sac internal detail reduces to a dot at120px, while paired sac bulges remain readable.
visualReview.devourer: Exposed crimson core, taller longer foreclaws and enlarged black maw clearly distinguish the final stage.
visualReview.smallSizes: All3 recognizable as dangerous bosses at120px;180px retains core/maw distinction and brood-sac forms more clearly. Fine crystal teeth and mint seams naturally lose detail at120px without harming the main silhouette.
visualReview.backgroundAndEdges: No white rectangular remnants, baked ground/base, external light ring or obvious white matte fringe seen on either background.
visualReview.directionAndFamily: Consistent front-down slightly right-facing family. Reference anchor is projected ground center, not alpha bottom or two front feet midpoint.

anchorInterpretation: SourceGround[512,850] is a declared projected body/ground reference; common family scale0.45 maps it to[256,435]. It is not inferred from alpha bounds, and no per-stage bbox scaling is used.
transparencyInterpretation: Compressed runtime PNG uses indexed palette plus tRNS transparency table and decodes toRGBA with partial alpha. It is true-alpha output, not an opaque white image; disk encoding is not colorType6 RGBA.
